definition_note: From 2013 includes sexual harassment, assault to disrobe, voyeurism and stalking (IPC 354A-354D, added by the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act 2013). In 2024 NCRB lists these separately, so they are added up.

legal_section: IPC/BNS and special and local laws
definition_note: All crimes against women NCRB counts that year, under the IPC/BNS and special and local laws. The special-law heads counted change over time (for example POCSO cases with girl victims from 2017), so part of a year-to-year change can come from what is counted.
